brief: 霓虹夜跑风格竞速赛车手游 UI 套件:主菜单 / 车库改装 / 赛道选择 / 比赛 HUD / 结算,横屏 1920x1080。

pages.role: Main menu — brand + player info, big start-race entry, secondary entries (garage/events/shop), resource bar.
Garage / tuning — current car display, car list, performance stat bars, tune & upgrade entries.
Event / track select — selectable track cards with difficulty, rewards, unlock condition, best time.
In-race HUD — speedometer, lap/rank, timer, minimap, boost item, steering/throttle/brake control zones.
Result — placement, time, currency earned & unlocks, retry/back entries.

styleAxes.mood: 霓虹夜跑:午夜暗蓝底色 + 高饱和氖光,速度感、电子感、夜赛霓虹街道。
styleAxes.accent: 主氖青 #00E5FF + 品红 #FF2D7E + 警示黄 #FFE100,点缀紫光,危险红用于刹车/高难。
styleAxes.type: 无衬线、宽字距大标题表达冲刺速度感;数字使用大号粗体强调里程表/计时。
styleAxes.density: 横屏左右分栏,中高密度;卡片圆角 + 细氖描边,自绘皮肤控件统一调性。
